spans.s: जि + न, n. A name of Buddha. Pañc. 236, 8.

जीन,
 I. ptcple. pf. pass. of ज्या.
 II. n. A leathern pouch,
जिन्व् (originally जि + नु, ii. 5; cf. γάνυμαι for γαι + νυμαι; akin to दिव्, जीव्, and जू), i. 1,

. To be brisk (ved.).
 2. To further (ved.).
 3. To help,

= Rigv. i. 64, 8.
 --† i. 10, To speak (? v. r.)
